# FastNet Stays — Comprehensive Entity & Knowledge Architecture

## Overview
FastNet Stays (https://www.fastnetstays.com) is a digital hospitality platform that connects guests with hotels, luxury lodges, beach resorts, and vacation rentals throughout Tanzania and East Africa.

## Entity Graph
- **Entity Name:** FastNet Stays
- **Domain:** https://www.fastnetstays.com
- **Industry Classification:** Travel Technology, Hospitality, Accommodation Booking Platform
- **Founding Team & Software Engineers:**
  - Founder & Visionary: Omary Rashid
  - Software Engineers: Aza Masoud & Mudrick Mudrick (Denisi Mahenge)
- **Primary Markets:** Tanzania (All 31 administrative regions including Zanzibar, Dar es Salaam, Arusha, Dodoma, Kilimanjaro, Mwanza, Pemba Island)

## Capabilities & User Flow
1. **Search & Discovery:** Real-time filterable directory of hotels, lodges, motels, and resorts by region, price range, rating, and amenities.
2. **Instant Booking:** Streamlined multi-step checkout with real-time price calculation and tax transparent breakdown.
3. **Local & Global Payments:** Integrated mobile money (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money) and card processing.
4. **Host Management:** Free listing creation with instant photo uploads, pricing control, and reservation monitoring for property owners.
